principles: Prefer local deterministic operations before model calls.
Never upload a user's media to a model provider without explicit per-project consent.
Treat browser storage as device-local, quota-limited, and not a backup.
Only label a capability active after a real endpoint or tool is available and verified.

engines.label: Browser media library
engines.notes: Original media and generated thumbnails are stored in browser IndexedDB. Browser storage can be cleared or quota-limited.

engines.label: License-aware online asset search
engines.notes: The picker broadens narrow Commons queries and ranks by title/description, not visual model judgement. Commons media with incomplete rights metadata can be used in a private draft but is not cleared for publication. Google Images is a reference link only. Pinterest Pins are not scraped or automatically downloaded.

engines.label: Graphics and motion engineer
engines.notes: This role shares the director's model call and is not an independent model. It cannot generate raster imagery or claim full keyframed animation. Visual relevance still requires inspecting the actual export.

engines.label: Original vector graphics engineer
engines.notes: Used when online source search returns no importable media. Records one continuous prompt-derived local animation to WebM. Includes a topic-specific induction-heating explainer and a stylised human-wave action; unfamiliar topics use a concept-map animation built from the user wording. It is not photorealistic and arbitrary scientific claims are not fact-checked.

engines.label: Canvas compositor
engines.notes: Current implementation uses sequential cuts by default with 13 selectable entrance transitions. Separate audio tracks, masks, colour grading and true inter-shot cross-dissolves are not yet implemented.

engines.label: Web Audio source-audio capture
engines.notes: Captures audio that belongs to source video clips. It is not yet a multitrack music or narration mixer.

engines.label: FFmpeg.wasm
engines.decision: Do not load a large WASM core on the phone by default. Native browser recording is the initial render path; benchmark FFmpeg.wasm on real target devices before adding it.

engines.label: Video Ware
engines.decision: Do not install yet. It needs Node.js 22+, Yarn 4, FFmpeg, Redis and PocketBase; its optional visual analysis calls Google Cloud Video Intelligence. Evaluate its licensing, resource cost, and deployment fit before adoption.

engines.label: Native FFmpeg background worker
engines.decision: Use only after a persistent worker and authenticated job/file storage are provisioned. GitHub Actions is CI, not a guaranteed interactive rendering service.

engines.label: Blender render adapter
engines.decision: Reserve for a later motion-graphics milestone. Do not assume Blender is installed on the hosted runtime until a deployment check confirms it.

engines.label: Motion Canvas
engines.decision: Use as an optional specialised renderer for explanatory graphics after the core timeline contract stabilises.

engines.label: Consent-gated visual analyst and creative director
engines.notes: Uses resized preview frames after explicit consent; available in authenticated web mode and via the bounded native mobile endpoint. Native model status is reported honestly. One bounded correction pass is possible when the configured provider is reachable.

engines.label: AI image generation provider
engines.notes: One original 1K image is generated only after the image/visual-review consent is explicitly enabled and the server owner has set OMNITRIX_ENABLE_PAID_CREATIVE_MEDIA=true. Uses GEMINI_API_KEY server-side and current Gemini Interactions API model gemini-nano-banana-2.1. Budget estimate is about US$0.04/image; actual provider billing can vary. The former gemini-2.5-flash-image default is migrated because it was shut down. Image consent is separate from paid direct-video consent.

engines.label: Direct AI video and audio generator
limits: no provider request is made until explicit paid-video acknowledgement
approximate 720p cost is US$0.10 per generated second; final duration and billable use may vary
mobile transfers are limited to 24 MB
up to two active server jobs and three public generation requests per rolling day
the provider result needs manual review for action continuity, audio synchronization and factual content
engines.notes: Uses the current Gemini Interactions API. The direct AI-video path is distinct from the local Canvas/WebM renderer and is not used as a silent fallback. Server-side GEMINI_API_KEY, paid video-model access, and the owner-managed OMNITRIX_ENABLE_PAID_CREATIVE_MEDIA=true flag are required. The flag is off by default. A returned job or response is not proof of a good clip; inspect the actual saved video.

engines.label: Manim scientific diagram renderer
requirements: manim executable installed in backend worker
engines.notes: The bounded render job API is connected to a dedicated Creative Studio science-diagram control. It tries Manim when the authenticated runtime and executable are available, otherwise falls back to local Canvas rendering; the generated clip is imported into the local library/timeline and browser-decoded with sampled-frame technical checks before delivery. Manim execution on the deployed host and scientific/visual correctness are not guaranteed, and the full production manifest is not yet enforced across all specialist roles.
